PDF export dependencies (bundled locally; no runtime CDN)

Noto Sans SC Regular and Bold, official regional subset OTF fonts.
SIL Open Font License 1.1, see OFL.txt.
https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk/tree/main/Sans/SubsetOTF/SC
These are unmodified upstream fonts. PDF generation embeds the glyphs used in each document.
